notablePrerequisites: Magnanimous Magistrate has at least five reprieve counters.
description:
Cast Deepglow Skate by paying {4}{U}.
Deepglow Skate enters the battlefield, doubling the number of reprieve counters on Magnanimous Magistrate.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Deepglow Skate, adding one mana of any color.
Deepglow Skate dies, triggering Magnanimous Magistrate, causing you to remove five reprieve counters from Magnanimous Magistrate and return Deepglow Skate from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
